name: Nightstand Clock
description: A bedside clock screensaver inspired by the landscape charging mode of phones: an analog or digital clock with a calendar, the weather or the date beside it, or one clock across the whole screen. Colors, time format and a red night mode are configurable.
author: taclab

settings.title: Layout
settings.description: A clock with a widget beside it, or one clock across the whole screen.

settings.title: Clock
settings.description: Analog has a rounded square dial, Analog round a circular one with every hour, Digital large numbers inside a ring of seconds.

settings.title: Widget
settings.description: What shows beside the clock. None centers the clock alone.

settings.title: Full screen clock
settings.description: Analog draws its ticks out to the edges of the screen with the date inside the dial. Digital shows large numbers under the date.

settings.title: Show seconds
settings.description: The sweeping second hand on analog clocks and the ring of seconds around the digital clock.

settings.title: Time format
settings.description: Automatic follows the language, not the separate 12/24-hour switch in Android settings.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Month, weekday and weather names. Automatic follows the device.

settings.title: First day of the week
settings.description: Used by the calendar. Automatic follows the language and region.

settings.title: Accent color
settings.description: Month name, today in the calendar and the date.

settings.title: Background color
settings.description: Keep it black on OLED screens.

settings.title: Weather entity
settings.description: A weather entity from Home Assistant, such as weather.home. Used by the Weather widget.

settings.title: Place name
settings.description: Shown above the temperature. Empty uses the entity's name.

settings.title: Night mode
settings.description: Draws everything in one dim color, red by default, so the screen does not light up the room.

settings.title: Night starts at
settings.description: Hour of the day, from 0 to 23.

settings.title: Night ends at
settings.description: Hour of the day, from 0 to 23.

settings.title: Night entity
settings.description: Night mode follows it: on, true and below_horizon (sun.sun) mean night. A numeric entity, such as an illuminance sensor, means night below the threshold. While the entity is unavailable, night mode keeps its last state.

settings.title: Darkness threshold
settings.description: For a numeric night entity: night starts below this value, in the entity's unit, and ends once the value climbs 10% above it (at least 1), so a flickering sensor does not switch back and forth.

settings.title: Night brightness
settings.description: Percent. Dims the clock on top of the screensaver brightness.
